subject: Sterile node hotpatch approval, artifact signing & deployment windows
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@terra-solutions.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@terra-solutions.com
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Sterile cluster - urgent hotpatch + signed artifacts request

Hey Jonas,

We just discovered a minor but customer-impacting issue in the tokenization path on our isolated retail cluster (sterile-node group). The fix is ready and packaged as a hotpatch (v1.2). Because this cluster is air-gapped, we need the signed artifact and the signer manifest before scheduling the physical handoff.

Can Redwood provide: 
- signed payload (tar + .sig)
- a signer roster (CSV) with required quorums
- recommended one-hour activation window during local night shift PST

Also please confirm whether the hotpatch includes any runtime config changes that need operator input.

Goal: acceptance window Fri 12 Feb 23:00-00:00 PST if possible.

Thanks,
Amira
--
Amira Hassan
Lead Site Ops
Terra Solutions
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@terra-solutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sterile cluster - urgent hotpatch + signed artifacts request

Amira —

Thanks for the heads up. We're aligned to support the Fri 2027-02-12 23:00-00:00 PST activation window. Quick notes and next steps: 

1) Artifacts & signing
- I'll coordinate the signing ceremony and produce the .sig file for the supplied tarball. Ben, can you stage the signature artifacts and the signer roster?

2) Quorum and acceptance
- Our standard sterile-site quorum for hotpatches is 3 signers + operator acceptance. If Terra requires a higher quorum, call it out now.

3) Runtime changes
- Karthik: the patch modifies tokenization mapping and toggles a new KV cache pruning flag (prune_lambda = 0.8) that needs operator opt-in during activation. Will that be an operational blocker for Terra?

4) Transport plan
- We'll upload the signed bundle to an encrypted USB handoff package and prepare a manifest. Please confirm courier window and onsite contact.

I'll attach the signer roster and initial manifest once Ben has produced them.

Jonas
Director, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@terra-solutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sterile cluster - urgent hotpatch + signed artifacts request

Jonas / Amira —

Attached: hotpatch-manifest-v1.2.json (metas + SHA256s), hotpatch-sterile-node-v1.2.tar.gz.sig (PKCS7 detached signature), signer-roster-20270209.csv

Attachment stubs: [hotpatch-manifest-v1.2.json (application/json), hotpatch-sterile-node-v1.2.tar.gz.sig (application/pgp-signature), signer-roster-20270209.csv (text/csv)]

Notes: 
- Roster lists 5 authorized signers from Redwood (ops-lead, infra-signer-1..3, product-approver). Required quorum = 3.
- The manifest flags 'requires_operator_toggle' = true for prune_lambda change. We'll include operator toggle instructions in the operator playbook.
- I validated SHA256s locally and they match the provided tarball (please confirm on your side before handoff).

Marissa — can you review the signer roster quickly and give production approval so I can finalize the signed package?

Ben
Senior Release Engineer
Redwood Inference

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sterile cluster - urgent hotpatch + signed artifacts request

All —

I've reviewed the signer-roster-20270209.csv and the manifest. Approve to proceed with the standard quorum (3) and the operator toggle in the playbook. Two operational clarifications before Ben finalizes the package:

- Operator playbook: include explicit step numbering and expected TTY output for the prune_lambda toggle so Terra on-site can mark acceptance in the manifest.
- Activation rollback: ensure the bundle contains a rollback snapshot and the signed rollback manifest (we should include rollback-manifest-v1.2.json in the handoff bundle).

Ben, please append the rollback manifest and reissue the signed tar.gz + sig. Jonas, once Ben posts the final signed bundle link I will sign off and hand the package over to courier ops.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Release & Field Ops
Redwood Inference
